candidate_budget.used_scope: all nine focused cases remain at used=1 across producer failure, S12 review resume, restart, concurrent recovery, dependency change and disabled-account rejection; the exhaustion probe sets used=max_allowed=3 only to prove the pre-model stop
candidate_budget.reset_scope: never reset by failure, restart or S12; replay validates the persisted RevisionBudget.used equals the checkpoint attempt and reuses that reservation instead of reserving another candidate
candidate_budget.note: RevisionBudget is persisted before generation_engineer; exact replay calls run_role_request with the persisted request and attempt, creates no new intent/usage/slot, and leaves the acceptance ledger unchanged

calls.note: Counting-stub total across the nine focused cases: 3 producer-failure, 3 restart, 1 exhaustion, 1 dependency, 1 unknown, 0 atomic-claim, 3 S12 review, 3 concurrent, 1 disabled. Failed provider calls are included; no visual submit calls occurred and no real provider network was used.

ticket_items.1_shared_persisted_candidate_budget: pass — normal producer failure, S12 review resume, full app restart and concurrent HTTP recovery all reuse one persisted prompt_plan RevisionBudget; failure and replay leave used=1, one intent, one GenerationUsage and three unreleased slots
ticket_items.2_zero_automatic_technical_retries: pass — status/refresh and repeated continue after S08 do not call a model; restart is read-only until explicit continue; post-failure model calls occur only through continue_workflow and are rejected before model when budget is exhausted, dependency is stale or the owner is disabled
ticket_items.3_unknown_submission_verification_no_res: pass — a persisted unknown GenerationJob blocks manual recovery with 409 GENERATION_UNKNOWN, leaves budget at 1 and creates no artifact or visual submit; supporting test_t68_recovery.py::test_unknown_verify_is_read_only_and_recover_polls_original verifies the original task read-only and test_v2_t16_unknown_recovery.py::test_original_submission_replay_returns_same_task_without_provider_call proves replay does not create a new submission
ticket_items.4_independent_connections_and_intent_mut: pass — two independent state.load_context sessions race claim_recovery; exactly one succeeds and the other gets 409 PROJECT_BUSY; HTTP overlap likewise returns PROJECT_BUSY before a second model call, while the successful replay produces one approved artifact
ticket_items.5_disabled_stale_auth_snapshot_dependenc: pass — disabled owner is rejected with 401 AUTH_REQUIRED before any model call; changed project revision is rejected with 409 STALE_RECOVERY; supporting test_t62_background_ownership.py::test_publish_rechecks_persisted_owner_before_writing_public_bytes and ::test_disabled_owner_cannot_make_another_model_call cover publish and post-restart model-call boundaries
ticket_items.6_no_double_acceptance_and_terminal_slot: pass — read-only verification, exact recovery and text replay keep one intent/one usage/three active slots; failure does not roll back acceptance; supporting test_t68_recovery.py::test_terminal_provider_failure_counts_once_and_releases_slots and ::test_result_fetch_failure_keeps_slot_and_recover_fetches_without_submit cover persisted terminal slot settlement
ticket_items.7_http_counting_adapters_temp_sqlite_reb: pass — each focused case drives the real HTTP application factory over real temporary SQLite with counting LLMStub and VisualStub; restart cases rebuild the app object while retaining the database; WG3-AC-07/08 are covered by the focused tests
ticket_items.8_test_seams_and_evidence_boundary: pass — tests use existing _environment/_setup_s06/_confirm/_normal_responder seams; tests are under backend/tests and evidence is under docs/acceptance; no test scaffolding or temporary evidence is written under main/

routing.retry_policy: zero automatic technical retries; only explicit continue_workflow manual recovery can replay a persisted model request; unknown submission stops auto-advance and never resends an image; exact request replay reuses the original candidate budget

unmigrated.full browser cross-tab and UI duplicate-: frontend/gate scope; backend HTTP overlap is covered here

residual_unknowns: No single aggregate full-suite pytest run was executed in this batch; verification is the focused 9-case suite plus a 55-test affected-group regression run. The full-suite timeout recorded by T07 remains unresolved.
model_text=16 is a counting-stub measurement, not production provider token/latency/cost data; no real provider network or image generation was used.
Unknown-submission verification is exercised against persisted GenerationJob/SQLite state and the read-only supporting t68 path; no real remote provider was available to verify a remote task.

Startup repair clears persisted recovery claims unconditionally on application startup; a multi-process race where another live process is still recovering was not exercised. The current deployment is a single-process SQLite app.
Cross-tab and lost-receipt behavior is covered at the HTTP idempotency/concurrency boundary; full browser cross-tab UI acceptance belongs to the frontend gate.
Publish isolation, disabled-owner publish rejection and false-cancellation copy are supported by existing t62/t68 tests in the regression group, not by a new T08-specific publish test.
